column2: NIAT requires 90 effective Working days (equivalent to 540 instructional hours), excluding holidays,Sundays, Graded Academic exams days and Induction days
Induction programme had to be under 6 days or a week in which 3 days will be allotted to NIAT
The academic calendar must be finalized before 1 month of University Start date
Effective working hours per day should be 6-7 hrs (exclusive of lunch, breaks)
Students need separate Bus facility and timings should be from x am to y pm.
Dedicated high-speed WiFi for NIAT classrooms (minimum 25 Mbps per classroom) should be there .
Projector  ,  Audio System ,  Air Conditioning , Backup Power ,  Computer Labs & Smart Boards should be there
Need hostel infra info in advance , university infra as well for bridge course delivery
NIAT conducts all internal continuous evaluations and semester end exam . (  Exam conduction , Evaluation and results publication all should be handled by NIAT)
All Internal  continuous evaluation  and  semester end exams should happen on Topin Tech  ( Nxtwave Assessment Platform) Digitally
if  any changes occur then it will require VC + NIAT Academic Council approval
Mandatory Professional Certifications, External Certifications  if univeristy is following that info should be passed to Curriculum teams as well ( Example Aurora university )
All BOS Signatures should be done before starting university

Once Academic Calender is finalized , no adhoc ,  unplanned  and extended  holidays should be given by university 

if allotted, that should be compensated. Atleast should allow to conduct online classes during day time.
